title: AI voice overs, or silence??????
author: Beneficial_Bid_5859
selftext:
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/4946330/Phantom\_of\_Orion/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4946330/Phantom_of_Orion/)

  
I made a ton of voice overs using AI for my game.  Another user suggested I just roll em out as a workshop item.  Since the code is all there, its just a simple drop in the folder mod and the game becomes fully voiced.  

  
I'm just so torn, I really like it with voices tbh.  

  
Its up for a 48H play test on steam if anyone wants to give it a go.

  
Its got some bugs, it needs some tuning, its a pre-alpha play test, been at this version of the game for around 8 weeks now.  Thanks for taking a look, my kids did the voices so that is my real drive for wanting them in, when I'm dead and gone they can look back and say "hey me an my old man did that!"

comments.author: 69Trash420Panda
comments.body: I think you should put in more large HUD elements covering most of the screen

replies.author: Droopy0093
replies.body: Agreed. That way he could be intentionally making AI slop instead of unintentionally doing it.

comments.author: Baelgul
comments.body: I think the voice overs are probably good to add in; it feels incredibly empty without any real sound there. At a minimum you want to have the sound of your own ship’s thruster or engine
